Subject: Reference & peer call requests — late-stage evaluation

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Solargrid loved the throughput numbers and the fallbacks you showed for peak ingestion. We're now in the final vendor validation phase and I need to pull together 2–3 peer calls (30 minutes each) with customers who are running Redwood in production for utility-scale solar asset management / predictive maintenance. Important criteria for my stakeholders:

- Customers with at least 12 months of live inference on time-series inputs (satellite + SCADA).
- Examples of latency SLAs at 100–200ms p50 for short sequences, and batching strategies for bulk reprocessing.
- Prefer customers in the US Midwest or Texas (grid/regulatory alignment).

Can you propose 2–3 references who fit? We may ask for an NDA before calls if needed (we have a short one we can send). Also happy to do time windows next week (Nov 23–25) for 30-min intro calls.

Attachments: list of our evaluation criteria (I can share formal doc if useful).

Best,
Sophie

3) For the Midwest/Texas preference — are you okay with customers headquartered elsewhere but operating fleets in those regions?
